sourceSteps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，脚趾指向前方。
将脚后跟抬离地面，尽可能高，用脚趾站立。
保持该姿势片刻，然后慢慢降低脚跟回到起始位置。
observation: Flat-foot unsupported stance to bilateral heel rise; both forefeet stay grounded and knees remain nearly straight; no wall or equipment.
scope: One reversible movement preview; lowering will only be synthesized by exact reversal after forward-phase review.

semanticRelationship.relationship: Both are bilateral plantarflexion. This exact1397 source has no hand support: paws stay free at hips and balance is unsupported. The distinction is supported versus unsupported balance, not a renamed view of the same wall-assisted clip.
